title: Us vs Them

script.script: Skin tags can start coming off overnight.

We Amish have had the remedy for this the whole time folks.

Big Pharma charges you hundreds for what is already sitting in your cabinet.

Most folks who come to me with this cover their neck all summer.

They wear sleeves to hide their armpits.

They avoid strapless dresses.

They avoid intimacy because they're embarrassed by skin tags in places they don't want to talk about.

They have tried every cream every freeze kit nothing worked.

Listen close.

Here is exactly what you do.

Take castor oil.

Apply it directly to the skin tag.

Roll it on before you go to bed.

When you wake up in the morning check on it.

If it has not changed repeat every night and give it time.

Within a few weeks that skin tag dries out shrinks and falls off on its own.

No cutting.

No bleeding.

No scarring.

Plain and simple.

Here is why it works.

A skin tag is not just a random piece of skin.

It has its own blood supply feeding it through a tiny stalk.

That is what keeps it alive.

The castor oil penetrates deep into the tissue all the way down to that stalk.

The ricinoleic acid in it cuts off the blood supply to the tag.

No blood flow means the tag cannot survive.

It starves.

It shrivels.

It falls off.

This is not a new discovery.

Our people have known this for generations.

But here is what nobody tells you folks.

Not all castor oil works for this.

Most castor oil you find at the store is refined and processed with a chemical called hexane.

That hexane strips out the ricinoleic acid which is the whole reason this remedy works.

Without ricinoleic acid you are just rubbing oil on your skin and hoping for the best.

You will be waiting forever and nothing will happen.

The castor oil that works is cold pressed.

Unrefined.

Hexane free.

With the ricinoleic acid still intact.

That is how our people have always made it.

But finding castor oil like that these days is near impossible.

The only castor oil I trust for this is Haven and Spool.

Cold pressed.

90 percent ricinoleic acid.

Hexane free.

USDA organic.

Nothing stripped out.

Nothing added.

Plain and simple the way it should be.

It comes in dark amber glass to protect the oil from light degradation.

And it has a rose quartz roller built right in.

So you do not have to get your hands messy.

You just roll it directly on the skin tag before bed and let it work while you sleep.

The only problem is this stuff sells out all the time.

They are a small company and when it is gone it takes weeks to restock.

You can find it directly through the link below.

60 day money back guarantee.

If your skin tags do not fall off every penny refunded.

They are running buy one get one free right now.

Grab it while it is still in stock.

Thanks for watching.

See you next time.
